sloka: धर्म लोपो महान् तावत् कृते हि अप्रति कुर्वतः ।अर्थ लोपः च मित्रस्य नाशे गुणवतो महान् ॥४-३३-४७॥
transliteration: dharma lopo mahān tāvat kṛte hi aprati kurvataḥ ।artha lopaḥ ca mitrasya nāśe guṇavato mahān ॥4-33-47॥

translations.english: 'Dharma is violated when we help not one who has helped. Loss of a virtuous friend leads to great loss of wealth. It results in destruction.
